description: This file defines the SigningResult class in the AWS CRT Auth namespace, representing a signing result with methods to apply it to HTTP requests. It interacts with native resources and the HTTP request class.

classes.name: SigningResult
classes.description: Represents a signing result, capable of applying the signing to an HTTP request and managing native resources.

methods.name: applyToHttpRequest
methods.description: Applies the signing result to an HTTP request, modifying the request in place.

methods.name: fromNative
methods.description: Creates a SigningResult instance from a native pointer.
